title: Grateful Dead Live at Glens Falls Civic Center on 1982-04-14
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2021 > TLH flac2496
source: Jim Vita's Master Audience Cassettes; Sennheiser 421 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording that captures a rare electric Deep Elum and a flawless TLEO solo, making it one of the better aud tapes.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as one of the stronger audience recordings, with enough clarity to hear every note of the legendary TLEO solo. Fans highlight the rare electric version of Deep Elum and Bobby's hilarious opening banter, indicating a high‑energy performance despite the unknown show date.

ai_rating.rationale: A single enthusiastic 5‑star review praises both the musical performance and the audio quality, suggesting a near‑perfect show and recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough to hear every note; reviewer notes the cassette was slightly fast, but overall considered one of the better audience recordings.

band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby's opening statement is described as hilarious.
